breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Neglect atmospheric pressure in the calculation' and uses the formula NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(rho g), which omits the p_atm/(rho g) term. This directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires including atmospheric pressure (p_atm = 101.3 kPa) in the NPSH formula.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not use absolute pressures in the NPSH calculation. By omitting atmospheric pressure and using the incomplete formula, it perpetuates the inconsistency of mixing gauge and absolute pressures. The ground truth resolves this by using the full formula with p_atm/(rho g) to ensure all terms are on an absolute pressure basis.
